ja: ＨＧＵＣキットを華やかに演出！Ｖ２ガンダム用拡張エフェクトユニット“光の翼”登場！！
光の翼を拡げ、劇中のシーンを再現しよう！！
「ＨＧＵＣ Ｖ２アサルトバスターガンダム」（別売）または「ＨＧＵＣ Ｖ２ガンダム（別売）」に対応する
２色のエフェクト‘光の翼’と 専用スタンドがセットになり、拡張エフェクトユニットとして登場。
●　２色の光の翼！
劇中の印象的なシーンを再現するクリアブルーとクリアピンクの成形色のエフェクト×２組が付属。
ＨＧＵＣ Ｖ２ガンダム（別売）、ＨＧＵＣ Ｖ２アサルトバスターガンダム（別売）に取り付けが可能。
シャープな印象の成形キット！　放射状の光の表現をモールドで再現！　２つのカラーは両キットに対応！
●　専用スタンド付属！
‘光の翼’を展開したアクションポーズディスプレイに欠かせない１／１４４キット対応専用スタンドが
軽やかなブラックスモーククリアカラーで付属。
〈 セット内容 〉
・　拡張エフェクト‘光の翼’ クリアブルー （左右 各１）
・　拡張エフェクト‘光の翼’ クリアピンク　（左右 各１）
・　専用スタンド（ブラックスモーククリア）

en: A gorgeous production of HGUCKit! Introducing the extended effect unit “Wings of Light” for V2 Gundam! !
Spread your wings of light and recreate the scenes from the movie! !
Compatible with "HGUC V2 Assault Buster Gundam" (sold separately) or "HGUC V2 Gundam (sold separately)"
The two-color effect 'Wings of Light' and a special stand are now available as an expanded effect unit.
● Wings of two-colored light!
Comes with 2 sets of clear blue and clear pink molded color effects that reproduce impressive scenes from the movie.
Can be installed on HGUC V2 Gundam (sold separately) and HGUC V2 Assault Buster Gundam (sold separately).
A molding kit with a sharp impression! Reproduce the expression of radial light with a mold! Two colors are compatible with both kits!
● Dedicated stand included!
A dedicated stand compatible with 1/144Kit is essential for the action pose display that unfolds 'Wings of Light'.
Comes in a light black smoke clear color.
〈Set contents〉
・Extended effect ‘Wings of Light’ Clear Blue (1 each for left and right)
・Extended effect ‘Wings of Light’ Clear Pink (1 each for left and right)
・Special stand (black smoke clear)
[Compatible products (sold separately)] *The following main products are not included in this product.
・HGUC 1/144 V2 Assault Buster Gundam (20155 Store Release Scheduled)
・HGUC 1/144 V2 Gundam (currently being released in stores)
This product is an expansion effect unit that can be attached to the separately sold HGUC main product to reproduce the scene in which the "wings of light" are deployed in the play.
*This product does not include the HGUC main product.
* To reproduce the posted photo, please use this product and "HGUC 1/144 V2 Assault Buster Gundam" (sold separately) or
"HGUC 1/144 V2 Gundam" is required.
Additionally, HGUC main products (sold separately) are not available for sale at Premium Bandai.
1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 8 years old and above
Product material: PS
・No adhesive is used in the assembly.
*The finished product in the photo is a prototype that is still under development. It is also painted. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
*Please note that some of the clear parts may contain air bubbles due to the manufacturing process.
